<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Assign a case"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/exceptions/{caseId}/assignments"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Gives the case an owner (an operator id) and moves it to `ASSIGNED`.
Reassigning is allowed while the case is not resolved. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`. Publishes `ExceptionAssigned`.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry\nreuses it) that makes a retried request safe. Required on every POST\n(a PUT accepts it too); answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`\nwhen absent and 400 `idempotency-key-invalid` when it is longer than\n128 characters or not printable ASCII. A replay with the same key and\nthe same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response\nwith the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a\ndifferent request is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}},{"name":"X-Actor","in":"header","required":false,"description":"The operator identity the case's audit trail records for this\ncommand (an operator id, e.g. `op-jane`). A label, not\nauthentication: the service has no auth layer (fleet decision\n2026-09-11). Omitted (or blank) records `system`, the pre-header\nbehavior; a value with a NUL byte is 400 `invalid-actor`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64},"example":"op-jane"},{"name":"caseId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The case id (`case-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":6,"maxLength":64,"pattern":"^case-[^\\s/]+$"},"example":"case-1d2e3f4a-5b6c-4789-9abc-def012345678"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
